context.problem: No comprehensive audit logging system, data lineage not traceable, audit compliance impossible

decision.description: Implement comprehensive audit logging system with data lineage traceability and complete audit trail
decision.implementation: Create audit logging service, add data lineage tracking, implement audit trail for all data changes

alternatives.alternative: Continue with basic reconciliation logging only
alternatives.rejectedReason: Insufficient for audit compliance, no complete trail
Adds external dependency, not integrated with data pipeline
